## 第一次异常
```
#13 [90000001003b35e0] die at 9000000000224b7c
#14 [90000001003b3610] emulate_load_store_insn at 900000000022fd0c
#15 [90000001003b3660] do_ale at 90000000015d1210
#16 [90000001003b3680] _handle_ale at 9000000000222738
#17 [90000001003b37c0] skb_release_data at 900000000129f158
#18 [90000001003b3810] __kfree_skb at 90000000012a16f8
#19 [90000001003b3820] tcp_clean_rtx_queue.constprop.0 at 90000000013b93d0
#20 [90000001003b38e0] tcp_ack at 90000000013c0298
#21 [90000001003b39f0] tcp_rcv_established at 90000000013c2914
#22 [90000001003b3a50] tcp_v4_do_rcv at 90000000013d4254
#23 [90000001003b3a70] tcp_v4_rcv at 90000000013d7b44
```

触发异常的指令为:
```
0x900000000129f158 <skb_release_data+400>:      ld.bu           $t0, $s7, 2
```

查看 `_handle_ale`堆栈:
```
#16 [90000001003b3680] _handle_ale at 9000000000222738
    [PC: 9000000000222738 RA: 900000000129f158 SP: 90000001003b3680 SIZE: 320]
    90000001003b3680: 0000000000000000 900000000129f158
    90000001003b3690: 900000000231c000 90000001003b37c0
    90000001003b36a0: 0000000000000001 900000000802f090
    ...
```
而`_handle_ale`的堆栈为 `pt_regs`:
```
crash> pt_regs.regs  -x 90000001003b3680
  regs = {0x0, 0x900000000129f158, 0x900000000231c000, 0x90000001003b37c0, 0x1, 0x900000000802f090, 0x900000000802f090, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0, 0x4, 0x0, 0x14e0011d3, 0x900000010fb00190, 0xf, 0x64, 0x0, 0x0, 0x3c, 0x1e0, 0xffffffffd6b83be4, 0x2f, 0x9000000104bd4200, 0xffffff8000831480, 0x1, 0xffffffffffffffff, 0x0, 0x1, 0x2, 0x9000000104bd4200, 0x900000010fb00180, 0x3},
```

s7 为 `r30` 为 `0x900000010fb00180`

而`ld.bu`指令
